notes.title: Final Chapter 10 Dev Update + Previews!
notes.notes:
Ah, tired adventurer! Please, come inside from that dreadful weather and warm yourself next to the hearth!

Hello, everyone! This will be the final Dev Update for Chapter 10, and the game as a whole. What an incredible journey this has been! It's just about time to face down the final boss, or our own demons, depending on which path you took.

Alpha testing for the update will begin this weekend. My testers will have access to roughly 70% of the update at that time, giving them the opportunity to destroy my hopes and dreams (aka, make me fix stuff). They have also been going through the rest of the game, finding the smaller things that need corrections still. Nothing major, just misspellings, grammar issues, things like that. But they will all be fixed in the update.

At this time, I'm expecting things to wrap up in ~8 weeks. Again, this accounts for all of the endings coming in a single update. They won't be released piecemeal. The translators are all doing their part as well, to ensure that those are ready to go.

So, how about a few previews then. Here you go!

Also, I saw what you all were telling me about the follow up title. The title has now been slightly modified and will now be [i]Darkness and Desire[/i]. Thank you! If you have any questions, as always, feel free to ask! I'm always looking back at these announcements to answer!

Final note: In the days leading up to the release, I'll be doing daily announcements with special renders to celebrate the big finale. Hope you enjoy them!

-Droosk

notes.title: Christmas Renders + Chapter 10 Dev Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

I hope your holiday season is going well, for those who celebrate! For those who don't, I hope your upcoming weekend is most excellent! Dropping by today to share a pair of special renders from a pair of special ladies, plus give an update as to the development of the final chapter of Between Two Worlds. First, let's talk about the development.

To be blunt, it's going very well. I'm already approaching nearly 20,000 words of script written, and I haven't even gotten to the actual final fights, branches, or epilogues yet! This chapter is by far the most difficult as I work to tie up all the various threads of the story. I don't want the game to end like the TV show, Lost, and have people asking "But what about...". I'm really doing my best to ensure nothing is left out! Those of you on the harem route will be especially happy about things. It may be a bit of ego speaking, but I think I've written one of the greatest AVN scenes ever. It's a long awaited event. I'm sure you can guess, so I'll just leave it there.

Part of Chapter 10 also includes certain elements that will be answered in the follow-up project, which currently has a working title of Dark Desires. It is intended to be a prequel to BTW, which expands on the lore of the world of Euchora and how things have developed into the current situation. Note, I've worked hard to ensure that these events work in their own right. It won't be a "You HAVE to play the other game to figure it out!" kind of thing, don't worry.

I've already handed the script work that is done over to my beta testers for review, and art work will begin soon. I'm excited to share this final chapter with you all soon!

Now then, how about some pretty girls? First, here's Kaylee to wish you a Merry Christmas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288801/4852189769271c6d5957352310899cd9a37521f7.jpg[/img]

And, of course, her friend Bailey just has to take it a step further!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288801/e6e7921153e7a7c7a6be6c2253070498ff422ff9.png[/img]

As always, both of these images can be downloaded to keep, use as wallpapers, whatever, for free! Here are the links:

[url=https://www.dg-files.com/images/KayleeChristmas2024.png]Kaylee Christmas 2024[/url]
[url=https://www.dg-files.com/images/BaileyChristmas2024.png]Bailey Christmas 2024[/url]

Happy Holidays everyone! Have a safe and enjoyable new year!

-Droosk

notes.title: Final Chapter 9 Dev Update + Release Schedule!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! It's time for an update and the long awaited release schedule! After a successful initial alpha test, I've been able to really dig down and push through a LOT of work. I actually wrote the single largest scene in the entire game, which will be in Chapter 9! It has been an amazing few weeks, and I'm incredibly motivated right now. It feels good!

So, what to expect. I believe that primary art and animation work will be done the weekend of the 23rd. I will then shift my focus over to doing the music and sounds, which typically takes a few days at least. Beta testing will be begin no later than the 30th. Allowing time for revisions, corrections, etc, the release date will likely be....

[h1]September 12th![/h1]

I must say that this is preliminary and subject to change. I do not foresee it changing, but in a live development situation, it's possible. Also, if I manage to be faster, then it is entirely possible that the update will release earlier! Thank you all for your continued support and I look forward to hearing what you think of Chapter 9!

Just as a final note, I know that this update has been considerably longer than the previous ones. I apologize for that. It has been difficult due to having to set it up for the grand finale. Thankfully, since I know exactly where Chapter 10 is going, it will be a bit easier. The only downside is that I need to make a bunch of endings, along with variations within those endings. That being said, I don't expect Chapter 10 to take nearly as long as Chapter 9 did.

Again, thank you!

-Droosk

Hey, everyone! Just dropping by with some news and some new art for you! First, the news.

As of now, writing for Chapter 9 is functionally complete. It is undergoing review by my team for things like grammar, spelling, continuity, etc, but the writing is essentially done. Translators are on it as well. This is big because I can now focus entirely on the art and animation! I'm happy and excited to say that Chapter 9 is starting to wrap up! There is a lot happening in this update, including some events that fans of the game have been begging for since the very first release. In addition, there is some significant character growth that will have major impact in the final events of the game.

It has been a long and hard road, but the light at the end of the tunnel has appeared! There will be one final update in the near future that will include the planned release date, so keep an eye out!

Now, how about some new art? I have three new special renders for you all. One of Hannah, one of Emily, and one with Hannah and Skylar. As always, there are also links to download the images directly if you want. Let me know what you think of them! I do these partially to work on new techniques in the art, and it's nice to get feedback from you!

notes.title: Chapter 9 Dev Update #4!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone! Time for another check in and quick render drop. I'm currently in the middle of writing a pair of particularly special scenes with content that has been regularly requested from the very early days of the project. I'm just hoping to do them justice in the end. I'm also taking the occasional break to begin the process of mapping out the end-game properly. All of the choices, options, etc, all have to be tied up into a pretty little bow.

Oh, did I mention that your choices could actually result in the death of a character? That's right. There is actually a chance that what you've done along the way may have gotten someone killed in the end. There are technically two potential deaths, but any given playthrough can only possibly see one of them. Oh, and I won't be giving any hints as to who could be headed for an early demise.

One thing to note on this topic. In order for it to happen, you have to ignore some very blatant signs and warnings. Basically, you have to play like you just don't care what happens, as I'm not personally a fan of killing people off. But I also don't play evil characters, and there's an evil route in the game. It's all about player choice!

So the question is, do you think you've managed to do the unthinkable?

Who do you think might not make it back from Euchora?

-Droosk

notes.title: Chapter 7 Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288801/35b26eb446d66bc7c5008f3732a501da02c3ab25.png[/img]

[h1]Chapter 7 is nearly here![/h1]

Hello everyone! Yes, you read that correctly. It's almost time to continue the journey through Euchora! I'm tearing through the final stages of the update as quickly as I possibly can. As I write this, both computers are churning away through the renders and animations. Tomorrow will be a major coding day so that I can get the script out to my translators. Everything is coming together!

So, what can you expect?

Right now, I'm targeting Thursday, June 22nd*. That's less than 4 weeks from now! Chapter 7 is absolutely loaded with important decisions, branching paths, and in-depth narrative. That means they have to go through every possible choice and branch to make sure it not only works, but sticks to the story so far.

In addition, I know there was some complaint about the music usage in Chapter 6. I heard you, I listened. Chapter 7 will be significantly more diverse in music and sound effects. I intend to eventually go back and remaster the Chapter 6 music, but right now my focus is on delivering Chapter 7 to you.

I'm also working on an eventual chapter selection system, which will allow people to replay content on demand, but that's also something that is down the road. Due to the way that Between Two Worlds flows, and the implementation of the alignment system, it's a difficult project that will need to be tackled carefully to ensure it's done correctly. But it [i]will[/i] happen!

One final note. I have recently contracted someone to provide Simplified Chinese translations. I am hoping to have the game fully translated shortly after the release of Chapter 7. So for those of you who have been requesting that, it's coming! The native Italian translation is also ongoing, and will continue being implemented as it's finished.

That's it for now! I need to get back to work and finish this thing up.

Thanks for your continued interest. This journey isn't over yet!

-Droosk

Edit: Corrected dates. Had to redo a bunch of animations due to incorrect settings :(

Edit edit: Final change to release date. Adding 5 days, to June 22nd. This is to ensure that the translators have sufficient time to finish their work and get it checked. This will also allow for more in depth beta testing.

notes.title: Chapter 7 Development Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's time for an update on development and I'm excited to bring it to you. The worst is done, which was the design and creation of a bunch of all new environments. I had to learn new lighting techniques and processes, in addition to actually making it. But that is done, and work is moving along quickly. Here are some hard numbers:

[b]Environment Design - 85%[/b]
[b]Writing - 74%[/b]
[b]Rendering - 53%[/b]
[b]Animation - 60%[/b]
[b]Code - 53%[/b]

There are a total of 19 scenes being worked on for the chapter, with clearly defined pathing. Each path, good vs evil, will get 13 full and unique scenes, in addition to a bunch of splitting within the remaining shared 6 scenes. For those playing both paths, this chapter is shaping up to provide 3+ hours of new content.

Right now, I'm trying to get at least two scenes posed and rendered per week minimum. The beta test team has already run through the first half of Chapter 7 and the issues they found have all been addressed. This matters because it cuts down the testing and fixing once the update is finished. Letting them go through it while I continue working makes everything go even faster.

If everything goes to plan, I am hoping to have the full update in their hands in ~5 weeks, and then out to all of you about a week after that.

That's it for this dev update! I plan to do one more in a few weeks with final notes before digging in for the final run. Can't wait to see your theories and ideas once Chapter 7 comes out!

-Droosk

notes.title: Chapter 7 Dev Update!
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!

Time for an official dev update and preview image. Things are going well, and rendering is well underway. Update is a little over halfway done, and I'm picking up speed as I move into the second half of the chapter. I've made some incredible new environments for our group as they move through Euchora, along with some interesting new situations.

As I've said before, the paths will continue to diverge with Chapter 7. Some of the choices you make will cause major jumps in one direction or another. One decision in particular could end up locking you onto a path that you'll be unable to recover from (in terms of good or evil). So make sure you put that new "Named Saves" functionality to use! In case you didn't know, you can enable it in the Preferences menu.

Don't forget, we have a Discord server linked on the main store page. If you're interested in more frequent updates (or general game or off topic conversation!), you should check it out. I'm always active there, and I love to interact with all of you.

I'm aiming to finish the update within 6 to 7 weeks, depending on how the beta testing goes. As with the previous updates, it'll be another 2-3 hours of content on average, and move both the story and relationships forward.

I'll be back soon with another preview!

-Droosk

notes.title: Chapter 6 Dev Update #2 and sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288801/bc3aabb628c144b8f112ff7cbbf8e25d2d179290.png[/img]

Hello everyone! Time for another update on the progress of Chapter 6. I've been busy getting things done, and it's looking pretty good so far. It's almost certain that this will be longer than Chapter 5 was, and almost half of the content is branching paths. Be careful of your choices though. They have long lasting ramifications!

In addition to a dev update, just a quick announcement to let those of you who may be sitting on the sidelines and waiting know that the game is on sale! For the next week, you can pick up Between Two Worlds for $9.95.

Alright, business taken care of, let's talk about the development update! Here are the hard numbers:

[b]Creative Design:[/b] 66%
[b]Environment Design:[/b] 29%
[b]Writing:[/b] 50%
[b]Rendering:[/b] 11%
[b]Animation:[/b] 15%
[b]Code:[/b] 0%

As you can see, solid progress! The early scene rendering takes a bit longer due to the branching path rendering. Even though it's one scene, there are multiple variants. I do have an artist lined up to help with posing future scenes, so things will move even faster over time. It'll need to, as the the paths continue to split!

The target is still early to mid November for the next update, which will contain about 2 to 2.5 hours of new content on average for most players. This chapter will also see major movement in the primary storyline!

That's it for this update. Thanks for taking the time to read it, and I look forward to sharing some actual in game screenshots (or maybe an animation preview?) in the next update!

-Drooskati Games

notes.title: Chapter 6 Dev Update #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288801/21fda663b690a0d552fb887cf3095ab8da39a775.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288801/bc3aabb628c144b8f112ff7cbbf8e25d2d179290.png[/img]

Greetings everyone! For those of you in the USA, I hope you had an excellent Labor Day. For those outside the USA, I hope you had a terrific regular day!

First, let me say THANK YOU! I'm so glad that so many of you enjoyed Between Two Worlds. It's a story I've wanted to tell for a long time, and finally being able to share that story with so many people is incredible. This has been such an incredible journey, and there is still so much more to come!

Let's get on to the core purpose of this post. Even though it's only been a couple weeks since Chapter 5 was released, I've been hard at work making Chapter 6. No rest for the weary, right? Gotta keep up that smaller dev cycle! It's still fairly early in the process, but Chapter 6 is already shaping up to be even larger than 5 was. I'm only about a third of the way done with writing, and the script is already ~50 pages long. To compare, C5 was 106 pages. I'm crazy, I know.

So, how about some hard numbers then? Well, here is the current status of Chapter 6:

[b]Creative Design:[/b] 33%
[b]Environment Design:[/b] 21%
[b]Writing:[/b] 37%
[b]Rendering:[/b] 0%
[b]Animation:[/b] 6%
[b]Code:[/b] 0%

If you're interested in following development, I use Trello to keep track of it. You can find my Trello board [url=https://trello.com/b/gNvDauXz/between-two-worlds]here[/url].

I've started rendering scene 1, so that number will begin rising in the next couple days. I'm also going to start the process of looking for an artist to join me. The posing and rendering is absolutely the most time consuming part of this process, and as the game moves forward, this gets bigger and bigger. Especially with the branching paths.

Right now, I'm targeting early November for Chapter 6. That would be a roughly 12 week cycle, which as you all know is quite quick! In addition, I've started working on a Christmas special! I expect it to be smaller (in comparison to standard updates), maybe 15-20 minutes of content. But it'll be fun :)

Thanks for checking out this update, and I look forward to more content in the near future!

-Drooskati Games
